summary_en: The caller, Kiran, initiated the call expressing that the proposed three-kilowatt system was too expensive. The agent explained the total cost of ₹1,95,000, the government subsidy of ₹78,000, and the resulting out-of-pocket payment of ₹1,17,000. The caller objected to the price but inquired about the monthly EMI, which the agent clarified as starting from ₹2,999 for 48 months. After hearing the EMI details, the caller agreed to proceed and requested a free site survey. The caller provided his name as Kiran and his location as Velachery, specifying that Saturday would be a suitable time. The agent confirmed these details and stated that the team would contact him soon to schedule the survey. The call ended with the caller thanking the agent.
next_action: Team to contact the caller to schedule the free site survey for Saturday.
objections: The price of the three-kilowatt system was too high.
notes: Caller was initially price-sensitive but became agreeable after hearing the EMI breakdown and subsidy details.

lead_assessment.note: Priority score uses recorded business signals; it is not a conversion probability or contact consent.
